# Peak annotation

# Phase labels

            fontsize=8, color='#666666', style='italic', linespacing=0.85)

ax.set_ylim(2140, 2590)

ax.legend(loc='lower left', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#cccccc', fancybox=True)
